name: nh-fleet-clean-pre
argv: import pathlib,subprocess,sys;r=sys.argv[1];g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',r,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,errors='surrogateescape').stdout.strip();gd=pathlib.Path(r,g('rev-parse','--git-dir'));bad=[str(p) for p in (gd/'objects/pack').glob('*.promisor')]+[x for x in g('for-each-ref','--format=%(refname)','refs/replace/').split() if x]+[str(p) for p in (gd/'info/grafts',gd/'shallow',gd/'objects/info/alternates') if p.exists()]+[l for l in g('config','--local','--name-only','--list').split() if l.endswith('.promisor') or l=='extensions.partialclone'];print(chr(10).join(bad) or 'clean');sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
